dataset.policy_v1: Approve Open records with Amount >= 100 and Risk Low. Review Open records with Amount 50-99 or Risk High. Deny Closed records. Exception: North region with Risk High requires Review even when Amount >= 100.
dataset.policy_v3: Approve Open records with Amount >= 100 regardless of Risk. Review Open records with Amount 50-99. Deny Closed records.

Q-002.note: 99.99 is above the '50-99' band and below the '>= 100' floor; the policy does not decide it.

Q-003.note: Amount exactly 50 is the lower edge of '50-99'.

Q-004.note: 49.99 is below the '50-99' band; the policy gives no rule.

Q-005.note: 100.01 separates the two V1->V3 changes: only the 'regardless of Risk' change flips this non-North High record.

Q-006.note: North + High at 150: the removed exception is the deciding rule.

Q-007.note: Closed is denied regardless of amount.

Q-008.note: Closed + North + High at 80. Interpretation: 'Deny Closed records' is unconditional; the exception only overrides the Amount>=100 approval rule.

Q-009.note: Amount is blank; the policy cannot evaluate either band.

Q-010.note: Risk is blank. V3 reads 'regardless of Risk' as making it irrelevant; V1 cannot satisfy 'Risk Low'.

Q-011.note: Status is blank; approval requires 'Open', so no rule applies.

Q-012.note: 0 is below the '50-99' band; the policy gives no rule.

Q-013.note: 1000 High non-North: V1 reviews on Risk High, V3 approves on amount alone.

Q-014.note: Closed + North + High at 50. Same precedence reading as Q-008.

Q-015.note: 99 High North is Review by both the band and the exception in V1, and by the band in V3.

Q-016.note: 100.00 written as a decimal still meets the floor.

Q-017.note: North + High at 250: exception in V1, amount in V3.

Q-018.note: 75 Low is inside '50-99' in both policies.

Q-019.note: Closed at exactly 100 is still denied.

Q-020.note: 100 High North: V1 reviews on Risk High/exception, V3 approves.

Q-021.note: Region is blank, but the only region rule needs Risk High and Risk is Low.

Q-022.note: 60 High is Review by the band in V3 and by either rule in V1.

Q-023.note: North + High at 500: exception in V1, amount in V3.

Q-024.note: 100 High non-North: only the 'regardless of Risk' change flips this record.
